CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.exam_xc43e9.m1_top_zips AS
WITH zip_agg AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    COUNT(*) AS trips,
    ROUND(SUM(fare_amount), 2) AS total_fare
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
  HAVING COUNT(*) >= 200
),
total_revenue AS (
  SELECT SUM(total_fare) AS grand_total FROM zip_agg
),
ranked AS (
  SELECT
    z.*,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC) AS fare_rank,
    SUM(total_fare) OVER (ORDER BY total_fare DESC, pickup_zip ASC
        ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS cumulative_fare
  FROM zip_agg z
),
with_cumulative AS (
  SELECT
    r.*, 
    ROUND((cumulative_fare / (SELECT grand_total FROM total_revenue)) * 100, 2) AS cumulative_share_pct
  FROM ranked r
),
-- busiest hour per zip
busiest AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime) AS hour,
    COUNT(*) AS cnt
  FROM samples.nyctaxi.trips
  WHERE pickup_zip IS NOT NULL
    AND pickup_zip IN (SELECT pickup_zip FROM zip_agg)
  GROUP BY pickup_zip, EXTRACT(HOUR FROM tpep_pickup_datetime)
),
 b_hour AS (
  SELECT
    pickup_zip,
    MIN(hour) AS busiest_hour
  FROM (
    SELECT
      pickup_zip,
      hour,
      cnt,
      RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY pickup_zip ORDER BY cnt DESC, hour ASC) AS rnk
    FROM busiest
  ) t
  WHERE rnk = 1
  GROUP BY pickup_zip
)
SELECT
  c.pickup_zip,
  c.trips,
  c.total_fare,
  c.fare_rank,
  c.cumulative_share_pct,
  b_hour.busiest_hour
FROM with_cumulative c
JOIN b_hour ON c.pickup_zip = b_hour.pickup_zip
WHERE c.fare_rank <= 10
ORDER BY c.fare_rank;
SELECT COUNT(*) AS row_count FROM workspace.exam_xc43e9.m1_top_zips
